data.title: Al Thuraya Island
data.about:
AJMAL MAKAN Real Estate Development, a leader in urban and mixed-use developments, has launched its latest project, Al Thuraya Island in Sharjah. Strategically located near key landmarks in Sharjah and Dubai, Al Thuraya Island offers an exclusive beach area spanning 564,000 SQFT and expansive green spaces covering over 1.3 million SQFT. The Al Thuraya Island project features luxury villas and palaces, including the 5BR Sea Breeze Villa, 6 BR Serene Villa, 6BR Azura Villa, 8 BR Grandeur Villa, and 8BR Majestic Villa, providing residents with unparalleled opulence and comfort.

Situated on the Sharjah waterfront within AJMAL MAKAN city, Al Thuraya Island by Ajmal Makan enhances the allure of waterfront living. The island combines sustainability, distinctive architectural styles, modern furnishings, and state-of-the-art amenities. It epitomizes the concept of an advanced integrated city where residents enjoy luxury, comfort, and a healthy lifestyle amid natural beauty and pristine beaches. The Althuraya Island Location offers a unique living experience within a vibrant community, making it an ideal Al Thuraya Island investment.

characteristics_module.title: Where Luxury Meets Island Living!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Dh25 billion mixed-use development
  • Strategic 36km beachfront location
  • Eight interconnected islands with completed infrastructure
  • Dh220 million substation providing 700 MW of power
  • Final masterplan: 1,500 villas and 65 mid-rise buildings across six phases
  • Crystal Gulf with 38 rides designed by Jack Rouse Associates
  • 14 hotels, serviced apartments, a marina with 800 berths, a mall, hospital, and private university
  • High investor interest in Sharjah’s new mega projects

location_tile.title: Discover Al Thuraya Island in Sharjah
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description: The property, Al Thuraya Island in Sharjah, spans 117 acres along the northern coast of the UAE, near the border of Sharjah and Umm Al Quwain. The Al Thuraya Island project is initially planned as a low-rise residential development but will be rezoned as a mid-rise residential development with 10,000,000 square feet of primarily residential use. Althuraya Island Location will feature a Jumu’ah Mosque accommodating a congregation of 2,000, with ample open space around it. Additionally, Althuraya Island by Ajmal Makan at Al Hamriyah will offer various Island amenities such as services, shops, and more.
